name: Stored superbounce: a super, then the carried wall coyote as a dash boost
techNote: The stored wall jump's lab with the dash: cling to the post, hold down-left until the dot lands (wallCoyoteFrames 7 kept), run right, then dash right with jump on dash frame 2 (a super: 805 up, 900 momentum) and press jump again 3 ticks later. The super ends the dash, so getPlayerControlledInput runs within dashBoostMax (6) frames of it, and the stored count (4 left) makes that press a wall jump off no wall with the dash boost: SpecialWallJump(0.6, 0.6, up * 410), Velocity (-276, 730) plus 401 momentum up, while the super's momentum keeps the dot going right. The super alone peaks 328.8 (hitbox top 355.6), the stored wall jump without a dash 390.8; the stored superbounce 537 (top 564). The finish box (x 980-1180, bottom y 490) is out of reach of all of those, and of a superbounce off the post (527 at x 437, falling long before x 980).
